facts.rationale: Replace the permanent-latch claim with the exact branch structure and cross-callback reset lifetime, preserving numerical uncertainty.
facts.value: Any non-GA_Air value selects ft_80084FA8. In GA_Air, cmd_vars[2] equal to zero selects ft_80085154 followed by horizontal velocity orientation correction; negative x6A4_transNOffset.y then sets cmd_vars[2] to one. A nonzero cmd_vars[2] selects ftCommon_Fall with x44/x48 and ftCommon_8007D344 with common drift parameters multiplied by x28. The write is a local one-way latch, not permanent state: both SpecialHi entry routines reset cmd_vars[2] to zero. The translation-offset threshold does not itself establish a physical velocity apex, and this source does not establish that x28 reduces drift.

facts.rationale: Preserve the verified object-to-attribute handoff while making duration consumption conditional on the common routine's non-hammer branch.
facts.value: Receives an HSD_GObj, reads its Fighter userdata and MarsAttributes.x2C, and forwards the original object, false, and x2C to ftCo_LandingFallSpecial_Enter. Both local SpecialHi collision callbacks supply this wrapper on their later eligible descending path. The common entry interprets x2C as landing_lag: if ftCo_800C5240 succeeds it instead enters HammerLanding; otherwise it enters LandingFallSpecial with allow_interrupt false and animation rate (0.1F + fp->x2EC) / landing_lag.
